About Ghozt Brah

Hartford’s own. Every record comes from the wound, not the playlist.

His bio says it plain: he’s dropping all unreleased pain. That’s the posture of somebody who writes from real life — the weight he carries ends up in the music, and the music doesn’t flinch.

“HandCuffs” and “Live Like This” came straight from the artist in October 2026, and “See No Evil” is already moving on YouTube. This is his home on the web — the music, the videos, and the way to reach him, all in one place.

“Pain music that actually hurts.”
